evidence_snippets: This parameter specifies the CPU usage threshold at which new instances will be started to handle traffic, enabling you to balance between performance and cost, with lower values increasing performance and increasing cost, and higher values decreasing performance but also decreasing cost.
When a user's request is redirected, the HTTP status code will be set to the value of the redirect http response code parameter.
You can set the parameter to the value 0 to allow scaling to 0 instances to lower costs when no requests are being served.
